remarks: Looking for the perfect summer getaway? Look right here! Nestled in sought-after Saugatuck Shores, on a secluded cul-de-sac, this charming home boasts 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. Its airy design with expansive windows bathes the space in natural light, creating a serene atmosphere for unwinding. Revel in stunning vistas of both Long Island Sound and Bermuda Lagoon, accessible through French doors leading to a balcony-ideal for sipping your morning beverage and witnessing breathtaking sunrises. Steps away lies the harbor, offering opportunities for kayaking, paddleboarding, or a refreshing swim in calm waters. Take leisurely walks to the Cedar Point Yacht Club, immersing yourself in the charm of this beachside community. Plus, enjoy proximity to Westport's downtown, featuring upscale shops and dining, Longshore's golf and tennis amenities, and Compo Beach. As a bonus, all utilities and outdoor maintenance are included.  ***Leases under 90 days incur a 15% occupancy CT tax on first 30 days***
